title: DoorDash said it’s only received ‘several hundred’ orders from AI agents
quote: What I mean by that is if you look at where AI agents are today, we are seeing maybe several hundred orders in total from some of these third-party agents.

title: x402 · feat(svm): support for transaction v1 in batch-settlement + exact & upto refinements (PR #3971)
quote: Part 3 of 3 of SVM transaction v1 (SIMD-0385) support. This PR completes it, and its main payoff is batch settlement. ... Full redemption cycle: 625 -> 150 (4.2x fewer) transactions, 8.1M -> 5.75M lamports (-29%)

title: pay-kit · chore(ts): re-pin x402 to the rebased feat/svm-client-transaction-v1 (PR #406)
quote: x402-foundation/x402#3971 was rebased onto x402 main... The commit pay-kit pinned (3ce7a7aa) is no longer on feat/svm-client-transaction-v1, so this moves both x402 submodules to the rebased head and rebuilds the vendored packages.

title: mppx · fix(tempo): enforce the 15s sponsored validity floor (PR #1131)
quote: Enforces the fee payer's 15s remaining-validity floor (defaults.minRemainingValiditySeconds): the client refuses to sign a sponsored pull transaction for a Challenge with under 15s left, and checks again right before signing.

title: mppx · fix(tempo): measure validBefore in the sponsored pre-sign check (PR #1137)
quote: the fee payer enforces its 15s floor on the signed validBefore, which is fixed (now + 25s, capped at the expiry) before asynchronous preparation. With the default 5-minute expiry, preparation longer than about 10s produced a sponsored transaction the server had to reject.

title: mppx · feat(identity)!: share one identity nonce per 402 and split verifier and prover hooks (PR #1138)
quote: Breaking for mppx/identity implementers. ... Each 402 now gets one identity nonce, stored in every offer's challenge metadata as _mppx_identity.
